t: This is Bedford Square, a garden square in Bloomsbury, in the Borough of Camden. A number of people were born or died in the houses around it. The architect Arthur Cates was born here, and so was Hampden Moody, who commanded the Royal Engineers in China during the Second Opium War. The judge Simon Le Blanc and the painter John Scarlett Davis died here. So did Norman Warne, the editor at Frederick Warne who worked with Beatrix Potter on The Tale of Peter Rabbit and her later books.
